open_questions: Centroid remains inconclusive (no clear difference image) — additional difference imaging or high-resolution follow-up would confirm on-target and rule out the 26 could_cause blends.

Period 13.5962 d is about 2.2x the strongest rotation period (7.423 d sector 81, amplitude 10828 ppm) and near 6.1835 d sector 54 — no phase-curve swing (amplitude 166 ppm ratio_to_depth 0.06732) or spot shape, but activity monitoring would check the density mismatch (fit_log_density_ratio -0.9888, star_density_penalty 3.317).

Low SNR (19.15) with only 4 transits (share 0.4998) and secondary snr 6.912 depth 767.4 ppm offset 0.2972 — needs radial velocity or secondary-eclipse photometry to measure mass and confirm the secondary is noise/ellipsoidal versus a stellar companion, especially given xgboost planet_rank 0.18.
dossier.public_summary: A 2.4-ppt, 3-hour flat-bottomed dip repeats every 13.6 days around a nearby K dwarf implying a ~3.3-Earth-radius planet, with no odd-even change and steady depth across sectors and transits. The location is not pinned by centroid and the star is highly spotted, but a neighbour would need a deep stellar eclipse and the shape favours a planet, so a planet is the best explanation pending mass measurement.

reasons.why: Flat bottom strongly favours a planet transit over a V-shaped eclipsing binary; duration ratio 0.9905 also matches a central transit.
Planet-sized 3.28 Rearth with undiluted depth 2688 ppm and rp/rstar 0.05185, well below stellar regime.
No odd/even difference and sector_oe_max_sigma 0.06352 with no sectors over 3 sigma, against an EB at twice the period.

Depth consistent within each product (SPOC 2486 +/-200 ppm, QLP 1772 +/-324 ppm) and consistent per-transit p_consistent 0.23188054978271347, so p_constant 0.06072 not due to astrophysical change; top 3 share 1.0 not skewed to a few outliers.

Neighbours plausible_within_1px 0, and centroid_all not_run leaves no positive off-target evidence; unresolved blend would need a 42% eclipse on a faint star, less plausible than a 0.25% dip on target.
reasons.value: inconclusive, nearest neighbour 18 arcsec delta_mag 5.6 needs eclipse 0.4273
